To Whom It May Concern,  

I’ve had the pleasure of observing Aditya Srinivasan’s work as a Staff Product Manager at FinWise Technologies over the past two years. While our interactions were occasional, his contributions to the company’s fintech initiatives have been consistently impactful.  

Aditya’s strength lies in his ability to synthesize complex market dynamics into actionable strategies. For instance, he led a competitive analysis of three major fintech platforms, identifying gaps in their compliance workflows. This work directly informed the redesign of FinWise’s institutional onboarding process, reducing customer acquisition costs by 18% within six months. His roadmap planning for the company’s 2023 product cycle aligned engineering, design, and sales teams around a unified timeline, cutting delivery delays by 25%.  

His UX research expertise shone during a pivot to prioritize user-driven features in the mobile app. By analyzing 12 weeks of session recordings and feedback from 500+ users, he prioritized a simplified transaction interface, which increased user retention by 12% in Q4. Aditya also excels at balancing stakeholder priorities—when conflicting demands arose during a regulatory audit, he facilitated daily syncs between legal, product, and compliance teams, ensuring alignment without compromising timelines.  

Aditya’s work ethic is marked by relentless curiosity and a knack for turning data into decisions. He recently spearheaded a cross-team analytics initiative to refine pricing models, leveraging internal metrics to inform a 10% revenue uplift.  

I’m confident he’ll bring the same rigor and impact to any role he pursues. Please feel free to reach out for further details.  

Sincerely,
